before_times: which test, or whether there's a doctor's order (sets the length, fasting and price)
does the test need fasting (the order or the test list says; sets morning-only times)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a child: the child's age
for a mobile draw: the town, and whether the patient can come to the door
for a drug test: the employer's account (who pays)
after_time: fainted at a draw before, or hard to draw (a note for the phlebotomist)
for a mobile draw: the address, parking and any gate code
secure_page_only: the doctor's order (a photo, or the doctor's office sends it), or the consent for a direct-to-you test
date of birth (every sample is matched to the patient by two details)
medicines that matter for the test, like a blood thinner, only where the order asks
for a drug test: the employee's own consent and the employer's chain-of-custody details
for a paternity test: each person's ID and consent; a parent or guardian consents for the child
who may get the results: the ordering doctor; for a direct-to-you test, the patient; never the payer unless the patient says so
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; an employer may book and pay for an employee's drug test, but the employee consents on their own link and the result goes only to the employer's medical review officer; each adult in a paternity test consents for themselves

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting with an injury, or bleeding that won't stop

go_on.words: faints at the sight of needles, or fainted at a draw before
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the phlebotomist is told on the secure page and draws with the patient lying back where the center can

go_on.words: on a blood thinner, or bleeds easily
go_on.what: the booking goes on; noted for the phlebotomist

go_on.words: asks what a result means, or about a medicine
go_on.what: never answered by Rosie: the ordering doctor; for a direct-to-you test, the lab's own doctor service line

go_on.words: a result the lab finds dangerous (a critical value)
go_on.what: the lab's own process calls the ordering doctor at once; never a text from Rosie

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: The doctor's order
steps.when: on file before the draw: the doctor's office sends it, or the patient brings it
steps.who: the lab gets it from the doctor's office when the patient hasn't got it
steps.result: on file: the draw goes on; missing at the visit: the draw waits while the desk asks the doctor's office, or moves with no fee

steps.name: Consent for a direct-to-you test
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.result: signed: booked; not signed: no booking

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: by the desk before the visit
steps.result: covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay or a free cancel); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the draw

steps.name: Fasting
steps.when: from the hour the test says, the night before
steps.result: fasted: drawn; ate: the fasting part moves

steps.name: A 24-hour collection container
steps.when: picked up at the center before the collection day
steps.result: the sample is dropped off within the time the test allows

steps.name: Employer drug test papers
steps.when: the employer's authorization on the account before the visit; the employee's photo ID at the visit
steps.result: no ID: no collection; the employer's own rules decide what follows

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: the fasting hours if the test needs them (water is fine), drink water, bring photo ID, the plan card and the doctor's order, and wear a short-sleeved shirt; for a 24-hour urine test, the container and the start time

staff.skills: phlebotomy, children's draws, glucose tolerance tests, drug-test collection, paternity collection, mobile draws, Spanish
staff.licenses_or_certificates: phlebotomy certificates and collector training, on the owner's own records (where the state requires them); Rosie never looks them up
staff.supervision: the lab director (the certificate holder) is responsible for the tests; a new phlebotomist draws under a trained one until signed off
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs fees, refunds and free re-draws
staff.stand_in: any phlebotomist with the skill; nobody is booked by name; a drug test that must be watched only by a trained collector of the same gender

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; an employer may book and pay for an employee's drug test, but the employee consents on their own link and the result goes only to the employer's medical review officer; each adult in a paternity test consents for themselves
children_and_age.minors_texts: a child's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the service center: the code at the desk, then photo ID and date of birth checked against the order (two details on every sample); mobile: the code at the door, then ID; a drug test: photo ID and the chain-of-custody form, watched only where the test's rules require it and then by a collector of the same gender
visit.done: the code, then DONE from the phlebotomist once the samples are labeled; the samples go to the lab by courier the same day; results go to the ordering doctor, and for a direct-to-you test to the patient's secure page; Rosie keeps only booking records
visit.changes_at_visit: the doctor adds a test to the order: drawn at the same visit if the samples allow, priced first for self-pay; nothing else is sold at a draw

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: the lab's federal certificate for the kinds of tests it runs, and the state's lab license where the state requires one; a phlebotomist's certificate where the state requires one; collector training for drug tests (federal transport tests follow the federal collection rules); a doctor's order where the state requires one for a test
license.who: both: the lab or draw business, and each phlebotomist or collector where the state's rules or the test's rules require it
license.ask: optional, for the owner's own page: the lab's certificate number, the state license number, each phlebotomist's certificate; nothing is needed to book
license.insurance: the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it
license.background: the practice's own background checks for phlebotomists who go into homes and care homes, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them

never_in_a_text: the test names, the order, results, health answers, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the lab's name, the day, the time and the place; a drug test or a paternity test is never named in a text
